one_line: Shaiva poet-saint of the Tamil Bhakti era, famed for hymns on Shiva’s cremation-ground dance.

appearance.age_look: Late middle-aged, slight and wiry build, moving with intense, ascetic energy.
appearance.face: Angular oval face with pronounced cheekbones, deep brown complexion, sharp nose, slightly sunken cheeks, fine wrinkles at eyes; default expression is fierce, absorbed devotion with a small, knowing half-smile.
appearance.hair: Dark grey-black hair streaked with silver, parted in the middle and gathered into a tight low bun at the nape; a thin, plain off-white cotton headcloth (thundu) wraps over the top of the head and around the bun, leaving the forehead and ears visible.
appearance.costume: Simple early-medieval Tamil Shaiva devotee attire: a full-length, ankle-covering off-white cotton sari with a narrow faded madder-red border, draped in a practical single-shoulder style that covers the torso completely; underneath, a short-sleeved matching off-white blouse; the sari is a bit worn but clean, with soft handloom texture and very fine, almost invisible stripes; around her neck, a modest string of rudraksha beads and a small copper pendant; wrists have two thin copper bangles; feet bare but clean; ash (vibhuti) smeared in three horizontal lines across the forehead and a small red dot at the center.
appearance.signature: A small palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin cotton cord, held carefully in one hand, edges slightly frayed to show age and constant use.

ref_desc: Karaikkal Ammaiyar is a late middle-aged, deep-brown-complexioned Shaiva poet with angular features, grey-black hair in a low bun under an off-white headcloth, wearing an off-white sari with madder-red border, rudraksha beads, ash-marked forehead, and holding a palm-leaf manuscript bundle in muted off-white and red tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Karaikkal Ammaiyar: a late middle-aged Tamil Shaiva woman with a deep brown complexion, angular oval face, pronounced cheekbones and fine wrinkles, grey-black hair streaked with silver pulled into a tight low bun at the nape, partially wrapped by a thin off-white cotton headcloth that leaves her forehead and ears visible. She wears an early-medieval Tamil devotee’s full-length off-white cotton sari with a narrow madder-red border, draped modestly to cover her torso and legs completely in a practical single-shoulder style, over a short-sleeved off-white blouse; the fabric has a slightly worn handloom texture with very fine stripes. Show three horizontal ash lines and a small red dot on her forehead, a simple rudraksha bead necklace with a tiny copper pendant, two thin copper bangles, and bare, clean feet. Her default expression is fierce, focused devotion with a small half-smile. She holds a small palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with cotton cord as her signature prop. Use a muted palette of deep brown skin, off-white garments, madder red borders, dull copper jewelry, and soft grey-black hair, shown clearly from front, back, and side views.
